appearances.snippet: Total memory blackout from ages 4 to 10, the exact years, because I was responding to a comment of somebody else who had a memory blackout being a part of this program. The exact years that I was at Fort Hood on base. Later 80s, late, later 80s, early 90s, military brat, dad was a doctor doing residency adjacent to a bio lab at the army hospital. I wouldn't follow protocol as a kid after the program.

verification.notes: The episode transcript confirms that Owens read a viewer report attributed to Nika describing a memory blackout from ages four to ten at Fort Hood. This verifies that Nika was reported as saying it, not the underlying autobiographical memory claim.
